other_conditions: The deceased must have completed at least ninety days of service as a registered worker.
The deceased must have been registered with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must be the nominee or dependant of the deceased worker.
The death must be natural or caused by an accident during the course of employment.
For unregistered workers, the nominee/dependant is eligible upon production of a certificate from the builder or inspector confirming the deceased was a building worker.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 for natural death or ₹1,00,000 for death due to an accident during employment.
documents_required: Certificate from builder or inspector (for unregistered workers)
